title: "Join MIDSEA"

::: {.join}
::: {.join-intro}

Membership is **free** and open to anyone based in or working on South East
Asia — from first-year PhD students to senior professors, and from within and
beyond academia.

**What you get**

1. **Directory listing** — profile in the members directory with a link to your work.
2. **Annual symposium** — reduced registration and travel bursaries for ECRs.
3. **Slack & working groups** — disease-specific channels, shared pipelines, quick code reviews.
4. **Training access** — free seats in every MIDSEA summer school and short course.

:::
